fact: Chapter 5 is titled 'Products Of Divine Wisdom', and divine wisdom enhances our mentality and manifests in various ways

The virtues expressed in divine wisdom are listed as long life, riches, pleasantness, happiness, creativity, exploits, joy and dominion, said to be some of the products of divine wisdom listed in Proverbs chapter 3
Creativity is named as the FIRST manifestation of divine wisdom
Genesis 1:1-3 is quoted for creativity, ending 'And God said, Let there be light: and there was light'
Divine wisdom releases creative abilities to your mentality, giving you the ability to bring into being the things that hitherto did not exist, so you are not stranded in life
Proverbs 3:19 is quoted: 'The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens'
Psalm 104:24 is quoted: 'O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches'
God's wisdom is behind the creation of the world
Creativity is defined as the ability to tread realms that no one else has treaded before and still get results, and the ability to operate as a pace-setter in your calling and endeavour in life
Job 28:10 is cited, 'And his eye seeth every precious thing', against the idea that everything needed has already been created
We are heirs of God and joint-heirs with Jesus Christ, and are to join Him in the continuous process of creation right here on earth
Jacob in Genesis 30 is the example of creating what you need: he created what he needed to beat Laban to his tricks
You may have nothing to do with engineering, technology or computers, but when the creative abilities of God begin to find expression in you it shows wherever you go
You cannot be despised, because of the results that will speak for themselves
Divine wisdom is creative in nature, not afraid to take new steps; it initiates and mobilizes for new steps
Isaiah 43:19, 'Behold I do a new thing...', is called the philosophy of divine wisdom, which constantly initiates new things
The author says 'If you leave your job the way it was given to you, you're not better than a machine', because they could as well have put a machine on the job, since it cannot think
Creativity enhances your productivity on the job and helps you not to expend so much energy and sweat, as you have a better approach
Exploits is the second product: the wisdom of God communicates and generates exploits and mighty works
Matthew 13:54 records the astonishment 'Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?'
Mark 6:2 records them asking 'what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?'
Mighty works are direct products of divine wisdom, producing results that cannot be denied by natural men: a peaceful family life, progressive business and outstanding finances
Mighty works are products of a mighty source, which is divine wisdom
Authority is the third product: divine wisdom delivers to you authority over the forces of darkness and imbues its possessor with the command he needs
Matthew 8:16 is quoted: 'he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick'
The author calls what Jesus gave the devils 'wisdom knockouts'
Proverbs 8:15 is cited for wisdom carrying authority: 'by me kings reign and princes decree justice'
Jesus was not just talking the spirits out of people nor praying them out, He was ordering them out
Matthew 8:28-32 is cited for a level of wisdom that will order the devil out of any place, and in verse 26 He rebuked the wind and the storm and there was a great calm
Divine wisdom put Daniel in charge: the king put all the magicians, Chaldeans, astrologers and sorcerers under him
Joy is the fourth product, and Proverbs 3:13 is quoted: 'Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding'
Divine wisdom communicates joy unspeakable, full of glory, cited as 1 Peter 1:8
Divine wisdom causes you to be on top all the time, so you always have a reason to be excited even in the midst of challenges
Isaiah 12:3 is cited, 'with joy shall ye draw water out of the well of salvation', because that excitement is what opens you up to mental excellence
The chain from joy is that when there is joy there is health, and when there is health long life is guaranteed
Wealth is the fifth product, and wealth is a product of wits
Proverbs 3:16 is quoted: 'Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour'
The wisest Being in the entire universe is also the wealthiest Being, God, whom the Bible calls the only wise God, and there is no one else in His class
Psalm 24:1 is cited: 'the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof, and all that dwell in it', meaning God owns everything we have, including ourselves

The poultry analogy: if you own a farm, both the chickens and all their wealth are yours; likewise both you and everything you own are God's, and you are created for His pleasure because you are in His farm
Solomon, the wisest man that lived in his time, was also the wealthiest man in his time
Somebody said that wealth is the product of man's capacity to think, and wealth is a product of man's Intelligence Quotient, his IQ
According to Proverbs 15:13-16 a man of wisdom is a happy, healthy and rich man, who will also naturally enjoy honour
Pleasantness and peace is the sixth product: divine wisdom guarantees a pressure-free life
Proverbs 3:17 says of wisdom that 'her ways are ways of pleasantness', and that 'all her paths are peace'
Divine wisdom frees men from pressures, bringing them into pleasures
When you see pressure mounting there is something reducing somewhere: it is an indication that divine wisdom is receding, because divine wisdom does not walk along the same path as pressures
God gave Solomon rest on every side so that there was no adversary or evil occurrence all through his reign as king, because he operated in divine wisdom
Pressure is of the devil: he gathers pressure around you so he can steal your blessings and rob you of your substance
Dominion is the seventh product: the wisdom of God guarantees dominion over the forces of wickedness
It was divine wisdom that made Daniel master over the Chaldeans, astrologers, magicians, sorcerers, witches and wizards
Isaiah 11:9 is quoted: 'They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea'
The wisdom of God is able to destroy all hurts, evils, regrets, failures and defeats
Answers is the eighth product: divine wisdom delivers answers to life's probing questions
Luke 2:47 is cited: the doctors were astounded at Jesus' understanding and answers
No matter the question, divine wisdom has an answer, since there is no one God would refer a question to
All the doctors of law and Pharisees sat around Jesus and could not match His wits; His answers were far above their realm and He levelled out their questions without any stress
Without divine wisdom, no matter how much money you have, you will still live under pressure
The foolish rich man wants to do something costing 16 million naira and goes begging house to house, though he has 10 million naira in hand and refuses to do something with what he has
God's wisdom bailed the author out many years ago when he made up his mind that no condition under heaven would bring him to the point where he would need to borrow
If borrowing becomes your habit, then lying would have dominion over you
Most of the troubles of man are all self-caused
Many people have died of the plague of debt, only it does not show in the autopsy: what the doctors see is high blood pressure, but the truth is that he died from debt-pressure
God's wisdom is full of good fruits, so look out for it
